svg.title: L07 — Directed vehicle pose graph and real rear-steer quarter turn
svg.desc: Vehicle routes on reserved clear floor, four zone gateways and six service poses. Teal routes permit the conditional loaded envelope; violet routes are bare-unloaded only. Inset compares the moving front axle, root and explicit chassis yaw. No in-place spin, slot placement or operational payload approval.

g.text: 104 pose nodes · 284 directed edges · explicit root / front axle / yaw · conditional C08 eligibility
L05 dimensions unchanged: forklift 1.2 × 2.1 × 3.0 m; LONG 4.2 × 0.52 × 0.65 m across the forks.
Conditional loaded / empty-cradle network: 8–12 m reserved bands
Bare-unloaded only: no cargo or attached cradle; full envelope still checked
Gateways stop 0.05 m beyond required padding from the storage boundary. No internal slots or buffer pickup paths.
Actual service positions are retained. Cargo/pair permissions are checked separately from geometric transit.
F01/FL01 and F02/FL02 remain two shared existing pairs; opposite/reverse movements share capacity-1 reservations.
Continuous proof: exact line sweeps; ≤0.5° oriented component samples + analytic displacement inflation on arcs.
Synthetic geometry proposal. C08 payload/support and shared traffic scheduling remain required; no backend KPI or safety certification.
Yaw is explicit, not root tangent.
